event: Fiery smoke parts to reveal a goblin army in white helmets with wooden shields and spears marching out of the flames; orange march SFX '챙'. The floor-17 mission box above reads 'DEFEAT 30 GOBLIN WARRIORS.' VORTEXSCANS.COM watermark burned into the bottom edge of the art.
In a sunlit forest Gobang, the colossal tattooed barbarian with a small topknot and glowing eye, turns his massive shoulder: 'SUMMONER, YOU CALLED ME.' A voice off-panel calls 'MR. GOBANG.'
Bong Juhyeok grins and points a finger at the viewer, blue-tinted closeup: 'WIPE THEM ALL OUT.'

Gobang ignites — a colossal pillar of golden flame energy erupts around him as he roars 'GRARRR!' skyward, arms spread, blue speed lines and a white blast core. MANGAYY.ORG watermark in the top-right corner.
Gobang charges through the goblin ranks with a red rumble SFX '쿠구구구' as helmeted goblin warriors flank him in the foreground; a goblin growls 'GRR...?' (unclear which one).
Inset bordered panel: a helmeted goblin warrior with glowing red eyes and fangs lunges, thrusting his weapon through a streaked forest background — SFX 'KRAAASH!'
Wide shot: red SFX '챙 철컹' over an army of goblin silhouettes that resolves into ranks of helmeted goblins leveling long spears toward the viewer.

Gobang barrels through, his huge tattooed body crossing the frame with a golden aura streak and a heavy landing SFX '쿵'; goblin spears streak past on the white right side. VORTEXSCANS.COM watermark burned into the art.

Gobang's charge detonates through the goblin ranks — goblins sent flying mid-air among orange light streaks, purple crash SFX '콰앙', a goblin shrieks 'KIEEEEK!', another groans 'UGHK'; Gobang lands crouched, arms crossed, eyes glowing. Diagonal bottom edge.
A lone goblin spear tumbles through empty white air, purple crash SFX '콰앙' echoing.
Goblins crash into the forest floor among brown-striped trees, purple SFX '두두두'; another goblin spear spins down across the frame. Diagonal panel edges.
Juhyeok shields his eyes with one hand, grinning through a nervous sweat drop against fiery smoke: 'WOW... THAT PERFORMANCE IS INSANE.' Diagonal top edge.

A camouflaged K2 tank draped in tangled rental bicycles fires its barrel skyward in a huge explosion, blue SFX '아...다', on a dirt road — the punchline of Juhyeok's analogy: 'STRATEGY AND TACTICS ONLY WORK WHEN THE WEIGHT CLASSES ARE SIMILAR... IT'S LIKE THOUSANDS OF RENTAL BIKES TRYING TO FIGHT A K2 BLACK PANTHER TANK—IT WOULDN'T STAND A CHANCE!' VORTEXSCANS.COM watermark burned into the art.
In the forest Juhyeok stares stunned, grinning with a sweat drop — 'AMAZING.' — a laugh SFX '하하' beside his head; at the right edge a red-haired figure in dark assassin gear leaps into frame.
Against black and yellow lightning a pale-haired man screams in shock, eyes squeezed shut, purple SFX '써' — a witness reacts: 'BOM SANSA...?!' (unclear who speaks).
Chapter title card: the series logo in blue chrome lettering, production credits, and a large numeral 9 on white.

Floor 18 begins: the mission box reads '[FLOOR 18 MISSION: DEFEAT 30 GOBLIN ASSASSINS.]' over dark blue streaks that fade into a red-lit forest; blue rumble SFX '쿠...오오오'; goblin silhouettes scatter along a ridge ('기여..', '구계어...'); below, Juhyeok, a caped figure in dark gear, and Gobang stand facing the army with their backs to the viewer. Caption: 'FLOOR 18 IS GOBLIN ASSASSINS.'
'MOVE OUT.' — Juhyeok points from the lower left as Gobang launches forward, his colossal tattooed frame filling the frame against blue-white streaks; red SFX '쿵쿵'.

Goblin assassins in tattered dark cloaks and red face-masks, eyes glowing white, phase through the forest wrapped in cyan smoke, blue SFX '서벅쌕' — narration: 'SURPRISINGLY, THEY ARE MONSTERS THAT USE STEALTH SKILLS.' VORTEXSCANS.COM watermark burned into the art.

An assassin ambushes Gobang — a small goblin clinging to his chest shows only as a blue dashed outline; orange grip SFX '으어엇', blue chime SFX '띵~'; Gobang blinks down at it: '?'. MANGAYY.ORG watermark in the top-right corner; art dissolves out at the bottom edge.
Gobang stands bewildered in a forest clearing, arms spread, a fish resting on his head — '??' — purple SFX '쿵 움', blue SFX '두거억' as he stomps around searching for the hidden assassins.
Inset bordered panel overlapping the corner of the searching scene: Juhyeok recoils, sweat flying, hand raised — SFX '머쉑' — 'UH...'

On all fours over the teal grass, Gobang channels swirling golden energy arcs around his fists — 'THIS MIGHT NOT BE AS EASY AS I THOUGHT?' — then pounds the ground, black SFX '백': 'COME OUT! ASSASSINS ARE ALL COWARDS!'
Under a storm-grey sky, a vast dark tree-canopy mound looms through radiating speed lines as a booming 'MUHAHAHAHA' laugh rolls over it.

A lean man with swept-back auburn hair in dark sleeveless assassin gear stands hands-on-hips, head thrown back laughing (purple SFX '짓') against a radiant orange backdrop — 'YOU'VE SUFFERED WATCHING THAT IGNORANT BASTARD GOBANG'S STRATEGY UNTIL NOW. I WILL PURIFY YOUR EYES WITH A CLASSY WALKTHROUGH!' — while a chibi-fied Juhyeok slumps in the corner wreathed in purple gloom ('…….'). His boots break the panel's bottom border.

The dark-gear assassin ghosts through a dark navy void wreathed in cyan smoke, grinning, blue neon SFX '쉬웅' — 'THOSE GOBLINS' STEALTH IS NOTHING COMPARED TO MINE.' — a blue skill box flashing 'SHADOW STEP'. VORTEXSCANS.COM watermark burned into the bottom-left of the art.

In a golden void of spotlight beams, the assassin blitzes the goblin assassins — blue afterimages striking from every angle as the goblins burst into purple and green particle showers, purple SFX '셔개 챠챠' — while a blue system box tracks the completion condition '[COMPLETE CONDITION: GOBLIN ASSASSIN .../30]' with the kill counter racing upward (6, 7, 8, 9).
Juhyeok closeup, wide-eyed and open-mouthed in surprise; bubble below reads 'OH... KORSAK,'
Heavy-browed dark-haired man grins slyly ('KUKUKU...') against a blue glow; the flash bubble above said 'HE TOOK THE BAIT.'

Forest: the assassin flying-kicks the colossal Gobang ('MOVE IT, YOU PUNK!' inside art); Gobang calmly says 'I HELP TOO.'; narration above explains Korsak was anxious his screen time dropped thanks to Gobang

White-gloved hand wreathed in blue energy on a dark tech background, activation SFX burned in; Juhyeok's bubbles below: 'I NEED TO KEEP INCREASING THESE SUPER SWEET ABILITIES WITH THE PERKS.' 'AND...'
Juhyeok in his white tee stands in a blue forest hefting an ornate silver mace; VORTEXSCANS.COM watermark burned inside the art; bubble below: 'I'M ALREADY AROUND LEVEL 18 MYSELF.'
Juhyeok seen from behind, arms spread as a red-black aura erupts around him; bubble above: 'MY HIDDEN...'
A horse-headed figure wearing Juhyeok's white shirt rears back whinnying amid blue light shafts, holding the mace; bubble above: 'UNLEASHING THE WILD HORSE.'
Glamorous golden closeup of the horse head with long lashes and a smug smile, sparkles and rays; bubble above: 'I CHECKED ALL THE WALKTHROUGH INFO BEFORE ENTERING FLOOR 18.'

Dark forest: a goblin assassin glows blue through the trees as Juhyeok detects it, white burst at its head, creaking SFX; his bubbles above: 'THE GOBLIN ASSASSIN'S STEALTH SKILL IS LOW-LEVEL,' 'SO IF I CONCENTRATE, I CAN DETECT THEIR MOVEMENTS.'

Juhyeok's intense dark closeup, blue lightning in his hair, sweat drop, determined stare; bubbles above: '...NOTHING TO BE SCARED OF.' 'BECAUSE I PRACTICED SHADOW STEP ENOUGH WHILE REPEATING FLOOR 15!'

Juhyeok leaps swinging the mace through a misty dark forest, blue crescent slash arcs and SFX; a glowing blue goblin assassin recoils with a '?' burst; composite beat: inset closeup of his boot stomping bottom-left (VORTEXSCANS.COM watermark inside the inset) with a '?!' bubble beside it on white
Chibi-style Juhyeok tumbles screaming through a giant silver ring as a blue goblin assassin lunges at the edge ('KE-GIK?' tech bubble inside art); bubble below: 'WOAAH...! MY, MY BALANCE!!!!!'
The mace smashes a green goblin assassin's face in a pink-blue burst, SFX burned in and spilling below the art edge; standalone SFX on white above

Light-streak background with system box '[COMPLETION CONDITION: GOBLIN ASSASSIN 10 / 30]' burned in; below, Juhyeok stands atop a pile of defeated goblin assassins resting the pink-glowing mace on his shoulder

Orange halftone closeup of Juhyeok's smug blushing grin with a sweat drop; bubbles: 'I-I CAUGHT IT JUST AS INTENDED...' above and 'ANYWAY, FIRST SUCCESSFUL HUNT ON FLOOR 18!' straddling the bottom edge

Dark streak panel: whistle SFX, then a goblin assassin leaps down; Juhyeok looks up shocked as a red energy streak grazes his head ('!!' bubble straddling the bottom; unclear what the red attack is); VORTEXSCANS.COM burned inside the art

Tall composite on a dark streak background: a RED-HAIRED man with a fanged grin cuts goblin assassins apart with a glowing sword ('NICE.'), system boxes count '[GOBLIN ASSASSIN 18/30]' '25/30' '27/30', ending on a slashed assassin head flying amid teal splatter; 'THREE MORE TO GO!' bubble straddles the bottom; MANGAYY.ORG watermark over the faint top (unclear: this matches ch.7's two identical red-haired men)
Gobang's colossal golden-aura fist swings from the left while the red-haired man backflips out of the way, '!!!' alert marks over his head
Gobang charges roaring, twin fists wreathed in a golden explosion ring against a dark radial background, SFX burned in
Goblin assassins are blasted apart mid-air in golden bursts against a white hatched background, SFX around them

Forest: Gobang rolls and flips through the air over the red-haired man with a golden impact burst, SFX burned in; Juhyeok's bubble above: 'GOBANG, CONTINUE HELPING.'; jagged bubble below: 'GET LOST, YOU'RE IN MY WAY!'; VORTEXSCANS.COM burned in the art
Chibi face with closed eyes and a faint smirk on an orange question-mark background; bubble above: 'BUT WHERE IS SUMMONER BONG...?'
Light streaks collapse into a magenta-white energy explosion with a dark spiky-haired silhouette at its base, SFX burned in
Dark forest: Juhyeok sprints with his mace wreathed in blue energy as a goblin assassin hurls a blade at him (red slash arc, SFX burned in); 'HUEK!' bubble at the bottom edge

Juhyeok clutches his head, terrified, a blue flame aura erupting behind him, purple SFX burned in; VORTEXSCANS.COM banner burned in the art; bubble below: 'THAT WOULD HAVE BEEN DANGEROUS IF NOT FOR THE ENERGY SHIELD~!!'

Tilted panel: a goblin assassin dives from above with its dagger while Juhyeok falls back shielding his face, mace in hand, blue radial burst behind them, SFX burned in; weapon-draw SFX bubble above; caption below on the streaks: 'IS IT BECAUSE THE ADRENALINE IS PUMPING?'

Tilted panel: Juhyeok dashes through the dark forest wreathed in blue energy, red lightning 'V' streaks cracking behind him || Tilted panel: Juhyeok dashes through the dark forest wreathed in white-blue energy, giant red-pink lightning 'V' bolts cracking around him - continuation of the dash panel agent B cut at 123500 (his side shows the entry at ~122690). Caption above (excluded): 'IS IT BECAUSE THE ADRENALINE IS PUMPING?'; caption below (excluded): 'THE GOBLIN'S SWORD STRIKES LOOK LIKE SLOW MOTION.'

Juhyeok leaps through the dark forest swinging the silver mace, body wreathed in white-blue flame with a huge swoosh arc; below him two goblin assassins swing blades leaving red slash arcs and a white burst. Slow-motion caption above (excluded) narrates the moment.

Composite slow-motion kill panel: extreme closeup of Juhyeok's eye under a pink-lit fringe with caption 'IT FEELS LIKE THE WORLD HAS SLOWED DOWN.' burned inside, then a giant red X-shaped energy slash wrapped in pink lightning cleaves the frame - a figure bursts into pink splatter at the lower blade edge (unclear: goblin assassin or the white-haired ally), another bursts upper-right, and Juhyeok's shocked face stares from the right as a pink flood and SFX fill the panel. System notices below (excluded): S++ clear floor 18 + platinum badge.

Misty blue forest: an auburn-haired man in a dark sleeveless assassin vest sprints toward the viewer shouting, white alert mark by his head, knives at his belt; 'BONG...' bubble inside the art; VORTEXSCANS.COM watermark burned in (~131490-131555). Folded from the black stretch above: 'S++ CLEAR GRADE ON FLOOR 18' + platinum badge notices; from below: 'SUMMONER BONG!'

Misty forest: Juhyeok smiling sheepishly with a sweat drop, a glowing blue hologram status window floating at the left; the 'I THINK I GOT THE LAST HIT!' bubble overhangs from the stripes above (excluded), tail pointing at him - the speaker is Juhyeok himself.

Dark swirl-forest panel: Gobang (colossal barbarian, tattooed arms, fur belt, topknot) stands at the right beside an armored figure kneeling and clutching its helmet, tears streaming, screaming 'SUMMONER BONG....' (giant bubble inside the art, rim touching the divider above); Juhyeok's sweating head in the foreground bottom-left; purple Korean SFX glyphs stacked at the left.

TV-news composite panel on a blue halftone grid: a gray-haired suit commentator (red tie) speaks at right; dark inset top-left shows the Black Tower beside a black silhouette with a light burst (the S++ player's hidden identity); 'BREAKING NEWS' tab and blue lower-third banner '18 FLOORS CONSECUTIVE S++ CLEAR BREAKTHROUGH' burned in. Hexagon 'AFTER A 20-DAY HIATUS, AN ASTOUNDING 18 CONSECUTIVE FLOORS CLEARED WITH S++ GRADE.' overlaps the panel top (excluded above the art edge, burned inside below); further hexagons above/below (excluded): 'A NEW WIND IS BLOWING IN KOREA'S BLACK TOWER CLIMBING SCENE.', 'IT IS AN UNPRECEDENTED RECORD, AND THE HISTORY OF TOWER CLIMBING IS BEING REWRITTEN.'

Black transition panel: a bright star-lens flare bursts at center with a white Korean SFX glyph (broadcast-cut whoosh); hexagon 'NOT ONLY PLAYERS BUT THE ENTIRE NATION IS INTERESTED IN THE S++ PLAYER'S IDENTITY...' ends at the panel's top edge (excluded, folded).

Interior closeup: the maroon-haired man (long face-framing strands) sighs with eyes closed, purple shadow on his face, dark circuit-pattern bg; below, a miserable sweating Juhyeok looks down at a dark slate held out by a black-gloved hand in a dark sleeve (unclear whose hand; likely the maroon-haired man's). Big bubble above (excluded): 'HAAAAAH...' with a shadow-lines badge; dots bubble below (excluded): '......'

Room interior: Juhyeok (white tee, shocked, sweating) faces the maroon-haired man seen from behind (dark high-collar outfit, reddish-maroon hair tied low); Korean SFX 'JJAN!' (ta-da) between them. Folded bubbles above: 'M-MR. KORSAK,' + 'DON'T JUST SIGH; IF YOU HAVE SOMETHING TO SAY, SAY IT.' (Juhyeok) and 'YES, SIR.'; below (excluded): '...IT'S TOO FAST.'

Closeup of the maroon-haired man's face: eyes closed, a thin scar crossing his cheek, a sweat drop, dark navy bg with pink rim-light on his hair. Black bubble above (excluded): 'THE SPEED AT WHICH YOU ARE REALIZING YOUR TALENT.'

Room interior: Juhyeok points at his own chest with a finger, grinning sheepishly with a sweat drop, storage boxes and a cabinet behind; VORTEXSCANS.COM watermark burned in (~166440-166520). Folded bubbles: 'EHHH????' above and 'TALENT? WHO?' + 'SURELY NOT ME?' below (both excluded).

Comedic burst panel on an orange radial bg: Juhyeok waves both hands in modest refusal, blushing and laughing, white angel-wing burst behind him, Korean SFX 'HEOHEO' burned in. Folded bubbles: 'AYY, YOU'RE JOKING!' above and 'IT'S NOT A JOKE...' below (both excluded).

Composite analysis panel (right-side inset on white): top shows the maroon-haired man's chin/shoulder with a sweat drop, then a flashback inset of the slow-motion X-slash kill (Juhyeok's shocked face at the red blade, pink splatter). Folded spiky bubbles overlapping the inset: 'IT'S NOT A JOKE...' (above), 'THE SHADOW WALKER THAT SUMMONER BONG SHOWED AT THE END...', 'WAS A PERFECT MOVEMENT THAT EVEN I WOULD STRUGGLE TO COPY.', 'THAT MAKES IT EVEN MORE DANGEROUS.' (below).

The maroon-haired man shouts in profile against a cream light-ray bg, mouth wide, sweat on his cheek, dark high collar. Folded bubbles above/below: 'YOU WILL GRADUALLY FIND COMBAT FUN, YOU WILL GAIN CONFIDENCE!', 'DANGER INCREASES PROPORTIONALLY WITH THAT... BEING BRAVE IS DANGEROUS!' (red emphasis), 'WE PROMISED FROM THE START, DIDN'T WE?' (inside art), 'SAFETY FIRST, SELF-PRESERVATION!' (red emphasis).

Room interior: a black-gloved hand grips Juhyeok's shoulder as he grins nervously with a sweat drop, storage boxes behind. Folded bubbles overlapping the panel top: 'Y-YES, OF COURSE~!' and 'I'LL NEVER DO ANYTHING DANGEROUS AND JUST CATCH ABOUT ONE.'
Closeup of the maroon-haired man's resigned face: eyes closed, long hair strands hanging, a sweat drop, room bg. Folded bubble above (excluded): 'YES...' - his resigned reply.

Closeup of Juhyeok grinning nervously with a sweat drop, black-gloved hands on his shoulders from both sides, pale room bg with boxes. Spiky thought bubble above (excluded): 'I HAVE A BAD FEELING.' (unclear whose thought - positioned over Juhyeok but flows into the maroon-haired man's outburst below); giant purple burst bubble below (excluded) overlaps the panel bottom.

Final gag panel: the maroon-haired man clutches his head with both black-gloved hands, mouth stretched in a huge scream, tears and foam spraying, purple hell-light bg, Korean SFX 'KKIANG' burned in; VORTEXSCANS.COM watermark burned in at the bottom-left (~181030-181100). Folded purple burst bubble above (excluded): 'OUR SUMMONER... I FEEL LIKE HE'S DEFINITELY GOING TO CAUSE TROUBLE SOMEDAY!!!!'
